title: First band members, the ballroom and the Niles band name
summary: He names the first band's clarinet, banjo, bass and drum players, the ballroom and pavilion owned by brothers, and how a druggist named the band after his medicine.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh yeah, well, Edmund, Edmund Hall, Robert, Robert Hall, he was the first one to stay with us.

He played Clownet too. See, he learned to Clownet.
